selection: Every identical complete Natural exactly-12-contact document in both retained archives, in original full-schedule order; no latency-based selection.

measurement.host: One hosted job; eight sequential fresh Node processes, no matrix or parallel cells.
measurement.timer: Unchanged collector boundary: before input cloning, await default generation with real cooperative yields and final validation, then stop. Collector validation/repeats/hash/write separately recorded.
measurement.telemetry: CPU user/system, raw GC intervals, heap/RSS, MessagePort-based default-yield counts/time, context switches, runner/CPU/Node/cgroup identity.
measurement.overhead: Instrumentation is identical across cells and remains in observed wall times; no overhead subtraction or claimed release metric.
measurement.retention: Every first result, repeat comparison/recoverable matching-output alias, mismatch output, raw timing and telemetry retained.
measurement.limitations: 114-point diagnostic retention is smaller than the full 3600-point release corpus; cold calls are retained. This experiment cannot substitute for required acceptance or prove a universal runner cause.
measurement.stoppingRule: Stop after both fixed order-balanced blocks. No optimization, further acceptance run, threshold change, sample replacement or automatic numerical retry.
